name: DATAPRP
recent: Dataprep 近期有多项高层人事变动，包括执行主席、执行董事及首席财务官辞职，同时有一名新董事加入。公司正推进最多 10% 的私募配售，已于 11 月 6 日向交易所提交额外上市申请。大股东 Datuk Wira Shamshuri 在 10 月减持后于 11 月增持 1900 万股。
notable: 已于 11 月 6 日向 Bursa Securities 提交额外上市申请。
执行主席 Dr Wan Ahmad Rudirman、执行董事 Syahril Yusri 及首席财务官 Razina 相继辞职。
大股东 Datuk Wira Shamshuri 在 10 月减持后，于 11 月增持 1900 万股。
risks: 私募配售最多 10% 新股可能摊薄现有股东持股。
多名高层在短期内相继辞职，包括执行主席、执行董事及首席财务官。
大股东 Datuk Wira Shamshuri 在 10 月有减持记录。
earnings: 最近一期财报（截至 2025 年 3 月 31 日）营收为 MYR 983,000，净亏损 MYR 3,950,000，净利率为 -401.8%。

events.what_en: Additional listing application submitted to Bursa

recent_en: Dataprep has seen several senior management changes recently, including the resignations of its Executive Chairman, Executive Director and CFO, while a new director was appointed. The company is proceeding with a private placement of up to 10%, with an additional listing application submitted to Bursa on 6 November. Major shareholder Datuk Wira Shamshuri acquired 19 million shares in November after disposing shares in October.
notable_en: Proposed private placement of up to 10%, with additional listing application submitted to Bursa Securities on 6 November.
Executive Chairman Dr Wan Ahmad Rudirman, Executive Director Syahril Yusri and CFO Razina have resigned.
Major shareholder Datuk Wira Shamshuri acquired 19 million shares in November after disposing shares in October.
risks_en: Private placement of up to 10% new shares may dilute existing shareholders.
Several senior executives, including the Executive Chairman, Executive Director and CFO, resigned within a short period.
Major shareholder Datuk Wira Shamshuri had disposed of shares in October.
earnings_en: For the latest financial period ended 31 March 2025, revenue was MYR 983,000, net loss was MYR 3,950,000, and net margin was -401.8%.
